text.tspan: Character model sheet / turnaround of Pip: front, three-quarter,
side, and back views at consistent height, plus three facial
expressions, neutral plain background. Character: PIP: tiny
round fire-mouse pokemon, fluffball the size of Clara's hand,
soft cream-orange fur with cream belly, huge round black sparkle
eyes, bright orange flame-tuft on top of head that wiggles,
cream heart-patch on chest, stubby tail, red bandana with white
pokeball-print around neck, oversized paws, big-eyed Pokemon-
anime cel-shaded style, default expression is a giant happy
open-mouth smile mid-trip. bright Pokemon anime-style children's
book illustration, clean bold ink lines, cel-shaded with soft
gradients, big expressive eyes, sunny sky lighting with pink
sunset rim light, fluffy clouds, sparkling magic effects,
vibrant pastel palette, full-bleed, no text, no watermark.
